title.en: MALACANANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES DESIGNATING THE DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE (DOJ) AS THE REPRESENTATIVE OF THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES IN THE IMPLEMENTATION OF PD1718 ON MATTERS INVOLVING THE AIRLINE INDUSTRY

text.en:
The Secretary of Justice is hereby designated as the representative of the
President of the Philippines in the implementation of PD 1718 with regard to the enforcement of
any foreign judgment as specified in Section 4 thereof, or compliance with any request, order,
directive or subpoena issued by any legislative, administrative or judicial authority in any
jurisdiction outside of the Philippines involving the documents and information referred to in
Sections 3 and 5 also of PD 1718, insofar as they pertain directly or indirectly to matters
involving the airline industry.

The Civil Aeronautics Board (CAB) and the Department of Transportation
and Communications (DOTC) are directed to coordinate and assist the Secretary of Justice, as the
designated representative of the President of the Philippines, to facilitate the resolution of issues
and concerns affecting airline companies involving the implementation of PD 1718.

A Secretariat is hereby created to be composed of: one (1) Assistant
Solicitor General (ASG) and two (2) Solicitors whom the Solicitor General shall designate, two
(2) representatives from the Legal Office of the Office of the President (LO-OP), and one (1)
representative each from the CAB and the DOTC, who shall assist and extend their support to the
Secretary of Justice for the efficient discharge of his duties and functions.

This order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 5t day of January.
Two Thousand and Teb.
in the Year of Our Lord,
glen Mr. Aeroy
By the President:
